title: Tattoo Interview
description:
Interview someone with tattoos. Ask them at least 3 of the following questions:
What's the meaning of one of your tattoos?
Where are you from?
What was your first tattoo?
Why did you get it?
If you could remove a tattoo which one would it be and why?

You may film if you choose to and only if the interviewee consents.

title: Feel The Burn!
description:
Hold either:
- A Plank (straight back while resting only on your forearms and toes)
or
- A Squat (fully seated position with your hands out in front of you).

Choose your poison and hold it for 90 seconds to complete the challenge.

You may attempt only once and you must film this attempt.

title: Pet Interview
description:
Interview a person with a pet. Ask them the following questions:
 What is the owner's name?
What is the pet's name?
What breed is the pet?
How long have they had the pet for?
What's the most expensive/annoying thing the pet has ever done?

You may film if you choose to and only if the interviewee consents.

title: Run Monkey Run!
description: Go to the nearest park or grassy area. Do a 'monkey run' (running on all fours) for 30 seconds.\n\nYou must provide video evidence.

title: I Want It That Way
description:
Sing aloud the first verse and chorus of "I Want It That Way" by The Backstreet Boys.
Multiple players from your team may attept this challenge together. Each participating player gets a band.

You must film your attempt.

For the uninitiated... here are the lyrics:

You are my fire
The one desire
Believe when I say
I want it that way
Tell me why
Ain't nothin' but a heartache
Tell me why
Ain't nothing but a mistake
Tell me why
I never wanna hear you say
I want it that way

title: Seriously? I Know…
description:
Call any non-player and hold a phone call for 60 seconds using only the words 'Seriously' and 'I know'.

If they don't pick up on the first attempt or if they hang up within 60 seconds it's an instant veto.

You get one attempt.

title: Kanga-Race
description:
Verse a non-player in a kangaroo race.

You must both jump like a kangaroo past two stores or buildings. You start at the beginning of the first store/building and finish at the end of the second.

You must film your attempt only if your opponent consents.

title: Look! It's A Rainbow!
description:
Create a rainbow with the following colours:

Red
Yellow
Pink
Green
Orange
Purple
Blue

 You may only use natural organic items around you to construct your rainbow.

You must take a photo of your masterpiece.

title: Cartwheel Craziness
description:
Both you and a willing non-player must attempt a cartwheel.

You do not have to do a good cartwheel but it must be a genuine attempt.

Film your attempt only if the other person consents.

title: Months Alphabet Race
description:
Race a non-player to say the months of the year in alphabetical order. You do not have to win.

No practice beforehand - not even sneaky mental practice!

Film your attempt only if they consent.

title: Bird Hunt!
description: You must take a photo of 5 different species of bird.\n\nYou have 10 minutes. Your time starts now!

title: Fast Facts Quiz
description:
Ask a non-player to play fast facts with you. Film their attempt only if they consent. 

You must ask them the 10 questions listed below:

What colours are in the Australian flag?   (Ans: Blue + Red + White)

How many stars are in the southern cross?   (Ans: 5)

What 2 Aussie animals can be found on the Australian coat of arms?   ( Ans: Kangaroo & Emu)

What does CD stand for in terms of data storage?   ( Ans: Compact Disc)

What is the tallest building in Sydney CBD?   ( Ans: Either the Crown Tower or Centrepoint Tower) 

Name the 2 main bridges that allow traffic in and out of Sydney CBD.   ( Ans: ANZAC Bridge + Sydney Harbour Bridge)

Which body part has more bones - hands or feet?   ( Ans: Hands) 

What is a human's largest organ?   ( Ans: Skin )

Which one is not like the other?
- Wallabie
- Koala
- Joey
- Alligator
- Jabiru.   ( Ans: Alligator – it doesn’t live in Australia.)

In what state of Australia will you find the worlds happiest animal - the Quoka?   ( Ans: WA)


You may take one band once you've completed this game with the non-player.

title: Instant Veto
description:
UH OH!

This challenge is an instant veto. You must wait 8 minutes before scanning or participating in a challenge.

Sometimes that's the risk you take…
